# ui::LinearGradientBrush

Header: `winui/render/Brush.hpp`.

A linear gradient running along one [GradientAxis](namespace-ui.md#gradientaxis) of the painted bounds.

Flat-color drawing keeps taking a plain [`Color`](../core/color.md). A control that wants gradient chrome passes one of these to [Renderer::fill_rounded_rect_gradient()](renderer.md#fill_rounded_rect_gradient), and a [Shape](../controls/shapes.md#uishape) takes it as one alternative of [`Brush`](namespace-ui.md#brush).

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::LinearGradientBrush luna{
    .stops = {{0.0f, ui::Color::from_rgba(255, 255, 255)},
              {1.0f, ui::Color::from_rgba(214, 208, 197)}},
};
renderer.fill_rounded_rect_gradient(ui::Rect{0, 0, 75, 23}, 3.0f, luna);

auto rect = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
rect->set_fill(ui::LinearGradientBrush{.stops = luna.stops, .axis = ui::GradientAxis::Horizontal});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stops` | `GradientStops` |  | The color stops, in increasing `offset` order. Empty paints nothing. |
| `axis` | `GradientAxis` | `GradientAxis::Vertical` | The direction the stops run; Vertical by default. |
